notes.title: Firestoke Publisher Sale - LIVE NOW!
notes.content:
Join us in celebrating Firestoke's very first Publisher Sale on Steam with some scorching (sorry, we couldn't resist) discounts of up to 67%! This event features our entire catalogue including newly released gems like [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2060790/Hauntii/]Hauntii[/url]. Whether you're into beautiful adventures, strategic tower defense, or fast-paced platforming, we've got you covered. 

In addition to the games themselves, we're offering discounts on DLCs and Soundtracks, so you can enhance your gaming experience even further! Joy Spark - Initiated! 

Featured Games on Sale:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2060790/Hauntii/][b]Hauntii[/b][/url]
A beguiling adventure where you uncover the secrets of an expansive and mysterious world, haunting both the environment and its denizens to craft ingenious solutions to the many challenges that await.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1415220/Its_Only_Money/][b]It's Only Money[/b][/url]
The mayor of Rockhaven threw you down a hole into the Undercity. Why? Net worth too low. In this 1-4 player low-life simulation, emerge to the surface to steal from the rich, fight tycoons and reclaim the city block by block. Buy houses, businesses and whatever your materialistic heart desires!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1424860/Bish_Bash_Bots/][b]Bish Bash Bots[/b][/url]
Immerse yourself in a unique mix of casual tower defense strategy and all-out brawling action. Team up in couch co-op / online play or go it alone and fight to save the world by building upgradable turrets, unlocking gadgets, and bashing bots with giant hammers.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1363680/FALLING_OUT/][b]Falling Out[/b][/url]
Experience a light-hearted roguelite platformer where you take control of an oddball couple on a holiday from hell. Work together as you navigate randomly generated temples, dodging traps, slaying enemies, and crafting weapons in an attempt to escape before the temple floods.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/791200/Planet_Cube_Edge/][b]Planet Cube: Edge[/b][/url]
Get ready for high-speed adventuring set in a hand-crafted pixel art world, filled with precision platforming and thrills. Planet Cube is being invaded, and it's up to you to run, gun, jump, and dash your way through an underwater science complex, collecting firepower to turn the tables on a mysterious aggressor.

notes.title: We want YOU to nominate us for the Steam Awards!
notes.content:
Friends, cubes, countrymen!

Thank you for your support of Planet Cube: Edge since its release earlier this year.
We'd really love it if you could take a moment out of your day to nominate us for 'Best Game You Suck At' in the Steam Awards. 

Recognition in awards and events means a lot to indie developers and helps us keep the fire of creativity burning! 🔥

We know that Planet Cube: Edge posed a challenge to even the most skillful players with its precision platforming and unforgiving boss fights - we think 'Best Game You Suck At' would be a huge honour.

With love and best wishes,
Sunna Entertainment + Firestoke

notes.title: New Collectionist Game Mode
notes.content:
[b]For all our dear collectors![/b]

We have heard your requests  and decided to create a new Collectable Game Mode. This mode gives you the possibility to try to get all collectables of the game in a more efficient and fun way.

Use the new room navigation map to instantly get to any room of any of the levels you have already completed.  No need to replay a complete level just to find the missing collectables! 

[b]Happy Collecting Everyone!! [/b]

notes.title: Planet Cube: Edge has arrived!
notes.content:
We’re thrilled to announce that our action-packed, pixel art 2D platformer Planet Cube: Edge from developer Sunna Entertainment is available NOW! :) 

Sunna Entertainment’s epic is set across eight, beautifully hand-crafted pixel art levels, and filled with quirky and memorable characters. Planet Cube: Edge is a classic combination of being easy to learn but hard to master, delivering the kind of addictive ‘just one more go’ flow that players thrive on.

“We’re so excited to finally share Planet Cube: Edge with the world. The moment we set eyes upon the world of Planet Cube our team was mesmerised! Combining an eye-catching visual style with brutally fun game-play we were soon hooked,” said Paul Farley, CEO of Firestoke. “Sunna Entertainment have crafted a delightful slice of retro gaming fun that we hope indie gamers will love just as much as we do.”

To celebrate the launch and the 20% discount, we'll be hosting some guest streams throughout the week - keep an eye out! 

Thank you so much for being part of the community and following our journey. We really look forward to all your feedback!

notes.title: Release Date Announcement
notes.content:
We are very excited to finally announce the official release date for Planet Cube: Edge. This exciting precision platformer will be hitting Steam in less than one month on the 23rd of February 2023!

One of the developers at Sunna Entertainment, Emilio Monge Vasquez (CTO), shares with us:

"After years in the making, the launch date is finally here and we couldn't be happier for everyone to be able to enjoy Planet Cube Edge. The game reflects our original vision of quality, fun and variety for fans of the genre. And for newer fans of the genre, our vision of having an accessible precision platformer. Our focus was making a challenging game that helps you beat it, but doesn't do it in a way that takes away from that excitement of beating a challenging part.
 
Player feedback has been extremely positive from the first time we showcased it in public to these last few days when people playtested the full version. The launch date marks the start of players worldwide enjoying Planet Cube Edge, and we can't wait to see the reception!”

For more information, check out the Steam page, and don’t forget to add it to your wishlist!
